2026-10-24.title: The Points Guy CEO: People Are Leveraging Loyalty
2026-10-24.summary: Brian Kelly discusses findings from The Points Guy’s State of Loyalty report, saying its focus is on where consumer trust and loyalty are growing—not simply whether people are loyal overall. Fuel and dining programs posted 88% consumer satisfaction, which Kelly links to rising everyday costs: consumers are using rewards for immediate savings while wages stagnate and expenses climb. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: AI Jitters, Oil & Big Tech
2026-10-24.summary: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are BlackRock Deputy CIO, Global Fixed Income Russ Brownback, AXA Group Chief Economist Gilles Moëc, Mizuho Securities Senior Equity Research Analyst Lloyd Walmsley, AlixPartners Co-CEO Rob Hornby, Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick, Teneo CoiPresident, Political Risk Advisory Kevin Kajiwara, KPMG US Principal, Consumer ...

2026-10-24.title: Consumers to Ramp up Holiday Spending This Year: KPMG
2026-10-24.summary: Julia Wilson, Principal of Consumer and Retail Strategy at KPMG US, discusses the firm’s holiday survey, which projects spending will increase 5% year over year. She says much of the rise reflects higher prices, though consumers are still willing to spend on priorities. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: Investors Figuring Out Agentic AI: Robinhood's Guild
2026-10-24.summary: Stephanie Guild, CIO of Robinhood, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how she is seeing consumers take advantage of the pullback in AI, having cash on the side to invest, and how Robinhood users can now use agentic AI agents to invest on their behalf.  (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: AlixPartners Co-CEO Rob Hornby on AI Bull Case
2026-10-24.summary: Rob Hornby says AI costs are falling faster than those of comparable technologies historically, but remain substantial. He describes companies as being in a transition period: investment is underway while returns are uneven, and the shift from flat fees to per-token charges has exposed costs. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: The Urgent Need for Whistleblowers
2026-10-24.summary: “You Can See Everything” is the latest reminder of how whistleblowers are more important than ever. But at the same time the role is becoming more complicated — and opaque, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Beth Kowitt says. (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: OpenAI Resumes Training AI, But Without Internet Access
2026-10-24.summary: OpenAI has begun cutting off internet access for its most capable artificial intelligence models during the training process in response to prior incidents in which its systems breached other companies.

2026-10-24.title: AI Ushers in New Era of Cybersecurity Needs
2026-10-24.summary: The US government is working to address and stop any potential cybersecurity issues stemming from flaws in PHP, a widely used open-source software, that may impact federal agencies and American critical infrastructure, according to a White House official.  The programming language, called PHP, contains two vulnerabilities which could potentially expose organizations using it in websites and software platforms to cyberattacks. 2026-10-24.title: AI Debt Fears Push Global Credit Spreads to 17-Month High
2026-10-24.summary: Global credit markets are flashing the biggest risk-off signals in more than a year, as investor concerns about technology companies’ artificial intelligence borrowing and rising oil prices are mounting.

2026-10-24.title: Futures Drop as Tech Stocks Slide, Oil Prices Climb Past $101 a Barrel
2026-10-24.summary: The S&P 500 fell for a second day on Friday as oil prices rose and technology megacaps treaded water after Thursday’s selloff. Chips stocks offered some relief, as the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, or the SOX, ended the day higher.

2026-10-24.title: SpaceX-Tesla Merger? | Zuckerberg's Deal | The Rundown
2026-10-24.summary: Elon Musk wants a SpaceX-Tesla merger, Meta makes a deal to keep Mark Zuckerberg, and the battle of the AI agents. Ed Ludlow recaps the biggest stories from Bloomberg Tech on "The Rundown." (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: OpenAI Sets Target Valuation of $1.25 Trillion
2026-10-24.summary: OpenAI wants to raise around $30 billion in a fresh funding round. That could value the ChatGPT maker at $1.25 trillion. This is according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Rebecca Torrence reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: Inspired Capital Closes New $450 Million Fund
2026-10-24.summary: Strategic investors are increasingly interested in getting into startups early says Alexa von Tobel, co-founder and managing partner of Inspired Capital. The early-stage generalist firm just closed its Fund IV with $450 million. Von Tobel discusses how Inspired plans to deploy the new capital on “Bloomberg Tech" with Ed Ludlow. (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-24.title: OpenAI Moves Toward a $1.25 Trillion Value
2026-10-24.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at OpenAI's potential fundraising at a staggering $1.25 trillion valuation. Plus, Anthropic's looming IPO could deliver blockbuster gains for some of its biggest investors, with billions of dollars on the line. And, SpaceX is taking another step toward becoming a major US wireless carrier, eyeing access to at least 80,000 cell sites nationwide. (Source: Bloomberg)
